GRI 6: 6211.42 other garments of cotton (women's or girls'), 6211.42.10 other, 6211.42.10.92 other

classification.rationale: A bib apron of woven cotton is an 'other garment' of heading 6211. In-force ruling G83072 classified a cotton bib apron under the women's or girls' cotton 'other' line, whose current equivalent is 6211.42.10.92.
